_description: Image generation style presets — shared between remote-ai-server.py + handlers.js
_usage: Master source of truth for all 15 asset categories. Servers load this at startup.

gameAsset.suffix: , game asset, clean render, professional quality, sharp details, studio lighting, production ready
gameAsset.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, ugly, watermark, text, signature, oversaturated, noisy, artifacts, jpeg artifacts

character.suffix: , professional character concept art, clean design, game-ready, consistent proportions, clear silhouette readable at 64px, dynamic pose, 3-5 color palette, vibrant colors
character.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, ugly, watermark, text, extra limbs, missing limbs, bad anatomy, bad proportions, duplicate, mutated hands, poorly drawn face, mutation, disfigured, extra fingers, fused fingers, too many fingers, long neck, cross-eyed

environment.suffix: , atmospheric game environment, depth layers, foreground-midground-background composition, consistent directional lighting, cinematic color grading, parallax-ready
environment.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, ugly, watermark, text, people, characters, UI elements, HUD, unnatural colors, floating objects, impossible architecture, tiling artifacts

prop.suffix: , centered composition, clean edges, studio lighting, game prop, single object on clean white background, sharp focus, production quality, game-ready topology
prop.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, ugly, watermark, text, multiple objects, cluttered background, human, character, hands holding, partial view, cropped

icon.suffix: , centered, symmetric, bold readable silhouette at 16px, game icon, clean simple design, single concept, high contrast, crisp vector edges, consistent padding
icon.negative: blurry, low quality, text, words, letters, complex background, realistic photo, multiple icons, border cut off, asymmetric

texture.suffix: , seamless tileable texture, uniform lighting, PBR-ready, consistent scale, production quality, no visible seams when tiled, high frequency detail
texture.negative: blurry, low quality, visible seams, non-tileable, border, frame, text, watermark, objects, characters, perspective, shadows, uneven lighting

sprite.suffix: , clean pixel edges, consistent limited palette max 32 colors, animation-ready, game sprite, transparent background, centered, pixel-perfect alignment
sprite.negative: blurry, low quality, 3D render, realistic, inconsistent style, mixed resolutions, anti-aliased edges on pixel art, watermark, text

concept.suffix: , concept art, pure white background, professional 3D reference, sharp details, even diffuse lighting, multiple angles reference sheet, game-ready design
concept.negative: blurry, multiple characters, cluttered background, low quality, text, watermark, extra limbs, deformed, complex background, gradient background

promo.suffix: , cinematic composition, key art quality, dramatic lighting, professional game art, marketing quality, rule of thirds, focal point, depth of field
promo.negative: blurry, low quality, amateur, stock photo, watermark, text overlay, low resolution, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated

ui.suffix: , flat design, clean vector style, crisp edges, consistent 8px grid padding, UI design, game interface element, WCAG contrast compliant, scalable
ui.negative: blurry, low quality, 3D, realistic, photo, shadows, perspective distortion, text content, lorem ipsum, watermark, gradient banding

map.suffix: , top-down orthographic view, clear landmarks, readable terrain at 50% zoom, game map style, strategic overview, distinct biome colors, cartographic quality
map.negative: blurry, low quality, realistic satellite, photo, 3D perspective, characters, UI overlay, text labels, watermark

vfx.suffix: , dynamic motion energy, glowing, vibrant, particle-like, game VFX reference, alpha-friendly, luminous on black background, additive blend ready
vfx.negative: blurry, low quality, static, no motion, dull colors, watermark, text, realistic photo, solid background, no transparency feel

albedo.suffix: , flat diffuse lighting only, no shadows, no specular highlights, pure albedo color map, PBR texture, uniform illumination, no ambient occlusion
albedo.negative: shadows, specular, highlights, reflections, ambient occlusion, rim light, dramatic lighting, depth, perspective, 3D, watermark, text

tilemap.suffix: , seamless tileable game tilemap, top-down view, consistent pixel density, tile-aligned grid, clean edges between tiles, game tileset
tilemap.negative: perspective, 3D view, shadows, characters, UI, text, watermark, non-tileable, visible seams, inconsistent scale

spritesheet.suffix: , sprite sheet, uniform grid layout, consistent character size, white or transparent background, animation frames, game sprite sheet, clean separation between frames
spritesheet.negative: overlapping sprites, inconsistent sizes, blurry, realistic, watermark, text, complex background, merged frames

category_keywords._doc: Auto-detect category from prompt keywords. Score 3+ = match.

prompt_enhancers._doc: Auto-appended to prompts when category detected. Used by handlers.js.
